summary: Milestone 2026.05.180 ran for 96 minutes wall time (10:17–11:53 UTC). 6 of 10 tasks completed successfully. Two tasks were blocked by doomed-rerun discipline (exp1736 EBT gradient refinement, exp1743 FPGA/TSU hardware accounting) — both had prior failures without corrective prior_failures entries in the roadmap YAML. One cascade gate-block (exp1738) was correctly fired when exp1736 was retired. The sole compute-bound task (exp1740 Sudoku symbolic verification) required a retry after a 20-minute timeout on its first attempt, eventually completing in 908s on the second run with 94% EBM-verified solve rate. Lean4 backend was unavailable at eval time so its solve rate registered 0%. Key deliverables: TTT-Discover prototype (exp1737), Lean4 verifier bridge (exp1739), FR-11 self-distillation loop with utility_delta=0.137 (exp1741), EB-SLE reward-hacking verifier (exp1742).
bottlenecks_identified: exp1740 (Sudoku eval) timed out on first attempt (1201s silence); second attempt succeeded in 908s. Root cause likely: Lean4 runtime not available, causing silent block in the first run before fallback to python_constraint verifier triggered.

exp1736 and exp1743 consumed 6 retry-slot-minutes combined due to doomed-rerun blocks. Both had prior failures in the record but the planner did not include prior_failures fields in the roadmap YAML, triggering three-strike retirement each.
exp1738 (SOTA EBT benchmark) was correctly gate-blocked as upstream (exp1736) retired, but the gate check fired three times (2 minutes overhead) before the task was fully retired.
improvements_suggested: Planner must include prior_failures blocks for exp1736 (EBT gradient refinement) and exp1743 (FPGA/TSU hardware accounting) in the .181 roadmap, or retire them permanently via exclusion_manifest.yaml.

exp1740 should include an explicit Lean4 binary precondition check (per CLAUDE.md Pre-Launch Preconditions Discipline) so a missing lean4 executable emits blocked_lean4_not_available rather than silently timing out.

The exp1741 duration_s of 0.41s indicates the self-distillation loop ran with stub/mock inference rather than real model calls. Flag for adversarial review to verify utility_delta=0.137 is not a fabricated number.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Add exp1736 (EBT gradient refinement) to exclusion_manifest.yaml with retire_if_same_verdict. This lineage has 1 prior failure and the proposed approach does not address root cause.

Add exp1743 (FPGA/TSU hardware accounting) to exclusion_manifest.yaml or restructure with a concrete prior_failures block citing all 9 prior failures and a new technique. This is the single task consuming the most doomed-rerun noise budget.
Wire a Lean4 binary precondition check into exp1740-class tasks so failures surface as blocked_lean4_not_available rather than 20-minute timeout + retry cycle.
meta_reflection: The milestone produced substantive deliverables (Lean4 verifier bridge, TTT-Discover prototype, EB-SLE reward-hacking detection, FR-11 self-distillation) despite two doomed-rerun blocks and a compute-bound timeout. The doomed-rerun discipline is working correctly: it correctly blocked exp1736 and exp1743. The process gap is at the planner layer — the roadmap YAML must include prior_failures entries for known repeat-offenders before the conductor runs. The Lean4 availability issue in exp1740 is a pre-launch preconditions gap, not a fundamental scientific problem. The 0.41s duration for exp1741 warrants adversarial verification before the utility_delta claim is promoted to paper-v6.
